title: Lakshmana's narration to Hanuma
introduction: Lakshmana explains about Seetha's abduction and their inability to trace her whereabouts. As informed earlier by a demon freed from his curse and who became a celestial, Lakshmana says that they are searching for one Sugreeva, King of Vanmara-s, to befriend him in order to take help in searching for Seetha. Hanuma who is on a similar mission to befriend these two warriors, as instructed by Sugreeva in the earlier chapter, comes to a conclusion that the needs of both the friends would be fulfilled. Then Hanuma takes the two bothers on his back to the place where Sugreeva is hiding from Vali.
closing: Ramayana is said to have been composed basing on the letters of Gayatri Hymn. The letter ga in plavagottama is the 10th letter in Gayatri hymn, and up to now 9,000 verses are over, out of 24,000 of the total epic.
इति वल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे चतुर्थः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 4th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रहृष्टो हनुमान् कृत्यवान् इति तत् वचः |
श्रुत्वा मधुर भावम् च सुग्रीवम् मनसा गतः
verses.iast:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭo hanumān kṛtyavān iti tat vacaḥ |
śrutvā madhura bhāvam ca sugrīvam manasā gataḥ
verses.translation: Then that Hanuma, who has good deeds for his credit, on hearing the words of Lakshmana, and even knowing that they are finely meaningful, he rejoicingly recalled in his mind that Sugreeva's effort is going to fructify.

verses.devanagari:
भाव्यो राज्यागमः तस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः |
यत् अयम् कृत्यवान् प्राप्तः कृत्यम् च एतत् उपागतम्
verses.iast:
bhāvyo rājyāgamaḥ tasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ |
yat ayam kṛtyavān prāptaḥ kṛtyam ca etat upāgatam
verses.translation: "Conceivable is the retrieval of the kingdom by that great souled Sugreeva...and for which deed, this purposive Rama has come, and that deed desired by Rama is also achievable by Sugreeva, and thus all this has came by..." thus thought Hanuma.

verses.devanagari:
ततः परम संहृष्टः हनुमान् प्लवगोत्तमः |
प्रति उवाच ततो वाक्यम् रामम् वाक्य विशारदः
verses.iast:
tataḥ parama saṃhṛṣṭaḥ hanumān plavagottamaḥ |
prati uvāca tato vākyam rāmam vākya viśāradaḥ
verses.translation: Then Hanuma, the ablest flyer is thus very gladdened...and in turn then spoke to that very learned one, namely Rama.

verses.devanagari:
किम् अर्थम् त्वम् वनम् घोरम् पम्पा कानन मण्डितम् |
आगतः सानुजो दुर्गम् नाना व्याल मृग आयुतम्
verses.iast:
kim artham tvam vanam ghoram pampā kānana maṇḍitam |
āgataḥ sānujo durgam nānā vyāla mṛga āyutam
verses.translation: "What for you have come into these perilous forests hemming in Pampa Lake along with your brother, for these are impenetrable forests abounding with many a serpent and animal?" Thus Hanuma asked Rama.

glosses.meaning: many a, serpents, animals, abound with

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणो राम चोदितः |
आचचक्षे महात्मानम् रामम् दशरथात्मजम्
verses.iast:
tasya tad vacanam śrutvā lakṣmaṇo rāma coditaḥ |
ācacakṣe mahātmānam rāmam daśarathātmajam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Hanuma, Lakshmana motivated by Rama, narrated about the great soul Rama, the son of Dasharatha.

verses.devanagari:
राजा दशरथो नाम द्युतिमान् धर्म वत्सलः |
चातुर् वर्ण्यम् स्व धर्मेण नित्यम् एव अभिपालयन्
verses.iast:
rājā daśaratho nāma dyutimān dharma vatsalaḥ |
cātur varṇyam sva dharmeṇa nityam eva abhipālayan
verses.translation: "The king named Dasharatha, a resplendent one and the patron of virtue was ruling the four-caste system with its, and by his own rectitude, for he is also bound within that four-caste system...

verses.devanagari:
न द्वेष्टा विद्यते तस्य स तु द्वेष्टि न कंचन |
स तु सर्वेषु भूतेषु पितामह इव अपरः
verses.iast:
na dveṣṭA vidyate tasya sa tu dveṣṭi na kañcana |
sa tu sarveṣu bhUteṣu pitAmaha iva aparaḥ
verses.translation: There is none despising him, nor he despised any and for all the living beings he is like the Grandparent Brahma on earth...

glosses.meaning: he, but, for all, living beings

verses.devanagari:
अग्निष्टोमादिभिः यज्ञैः इष्टवान् आप्त दक्षिणैः |
तस्य अयम् पूर्वजः पुत्रो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः
verses.iast:
agniṣṭomādibhiḥ yajñaiḥ iṣṭavān āpta dakśiṇaiḥ |
tasya ayam pūrvajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ
verses.translation: "And he, King Dasharatha who performed rituals agniSToma and the like Vedic rituals wherein he donated liberally, and this one is his eldest son, and he is renowned among people by the name of Rama...

glosses.meaning: given are, the charities [liberal charities are given in rituals by him]

verses.devanagari:
शरण्यः सर्व भूतानाम् पितुः निर्देश पारगः |
ज्येष्टो दशरथस्य अयम् पुत्राणाम् गुणवत्तरः
राज लक्षण संयुक्तः संयुक्तो राज्य सम्पदा ||
राजात् भ्रष्टो मया वस्तुम् वने सार्धम् इह आगतः
verses.iast:
śaraṇyaḥ sarva bhūtānām pituḥ nirdeśa pāragaḥ |
jyeṣṭo daśarathasya ayam putrāṇām guṇavattaraḥ
rāja laxaṇa saṃyuktaḥ saṃyukto rājya sampadā ||
rājāt bhraṣṭo mayā vastum vane sārdham iha āgataḥ
verses.translation: "He is the protector of all beings and the follower of father's directives, he is the eldest one among the sons of King Dasharatha... possessor of high virtues, qualities and royal fortune befitting to a king... but he is deprived of his kingdom, and came hither to dwell in the forests... nevertheless, followed by me...

verses.devanagari:
भार्यया च महाभाग सीतया अनुगतो वशी |
दिन क्षये महातेजाः प्रभ एव दिवाकरः
verses.iast:
bhāryayā ca mahābhāga sītayā anugato vaśī |
dina kṣaye mahātejāḥ prabha eva divākaraḥ
verses.translation: "With his wife Seetha following him, oh, highly fortunate Hanuma, this self-controlled and highly resplendent Rama came to forests like the Sun followed by his consort Prabha, who vanishes when the day is abated...

glosses.meaning: with resplendence / Sun's consort Prabha, like

verses.devanagari:
अहम् अस्य अवरः भ्राता गुणैः दास्यम् उपागतः |
कृतज्ञस्य बहुज्ञस्य लक्ष्मणो नाम नामतः
verses.iast:
aham asya avaraḥ bhrātā guṇaiḥ dāsyam upāgataḥ |
kṛtajñasya bahujñasya lakṣmaṇo nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: "I am the one who obtained servitude by the justness of this faithful and knowledgeable one, and his younger brother, by name I am named as Lakshmana...

glosses.meaning: of this faithful one, knowledgeable one

verses.devanagari:
सुखार्हस्य महार्हस्य सर्वभूत हितात्मनः |
ऐश्वर्येण विहीनस्य वनवासे रतस्य च
रक्षस अपहृता भार्या रहिते काम रूपिणा |
तत् च न ज्ञायते रक्षः पत्नी येन अस्य वा हृता
verses.iast:
sukhārhasya mahārhasya sarvabhūta hitātmanaḥ |
aiśvaryeṇa vihīnasya vanavāse ratasya ca
rakṣasa apahṛtā bhāryā rahite kāma rūpiṇā |
tat ca na jñāyate rakṣaḥ patnī yena asya vā hṛtā
verses.translation: "He who aspires to keep up the well-being of all the beings, and he who is merited for all comforts and respectability is now devoid of his prosperity and predisposed to forest dwelling... such as he is, his wife is abducted by a guise changing demon in a lonely place, of whom we know not... we know not which demon stole his wife...
notes: The aspect of �helping the destitute' is retold here. Though Rama could have rejoiced in the nearby forests bordering Ayodhya for fourteen years without a bother, and could have regained his comforts and respectability, his mission to help the piteous sages and saints, and other god-forsaken creatures had to trigger off somewhere in the deep of woods. So while in woods his wife is stolen, paving a way for him to embark on his above mission.

glosses.meaning: for comforts, one who is eligible
for respectability, one who is eligible
for all, beings, well-being, he who aspires to
of prosperousness, one who is devoid of
such as he is, his wife is]
by demon, abducted, is his wife

verses.devanagari:
दनुः नाम दितेः पुत्रः शापात् राक्षसताम् गतः |
आख्यातः तेन सुग्रीवः समर्थो वानराधिपः
स ज्ञास्यति महावीर्यः तव भार्या अपहारिणम् |
एवम् उक्त्वा दनुः स्वर्गम् भ्राजमानो दिवम् गतः
verses.iast:
danuḥ nāma diteḥ putraḥ śāpāt rākṣasatām gataḥ |
ākhyātaḥ tena sugrīvaḥ samartho vānarādhipaḥ
sa jñāsyati mahāvīryaḥ tava bhāryā apahāriṇam |
evam uktvā danuḥ svargam bhrājamāno divam gataḥ
verses.translation: "One named Danu, son of Diti, who acquired demon-hood by curse had said that Sugreeva, the chief of monkeys, is a capable one, and he even said, "that great valorous Sugreeva can know about the abductor of your wife..." saying thus that Danu is released from the curse of his demon-hood, moved skyward and went away to heavens while becoming self-luminous...

verses.devanagari:
एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातम् याथातथ्येन पृच्छतः |
अहम् चैव च रामः च सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतौ
verses.iast:
etat te sarvam ākhyātam yāthātathyena pṛcchataḥ |
aham caiva ca rāmaḥ ca sugrīvam śaraṇam gatau
verses.translation: "All this is informed to you, as it is as you have asked..Myself and Rama, we now have our recourse to Sugreeva alone...

glosses.meaning: recourse to, we [already] went into [upon our word.]

verses.devanagari:
एष दत्त्वा च वित्तानि प्राप्य च अनुत्तमम् यशः |
लोकनाथः पुरा भूत्वा सुग्रीवम् नाथम् इच्छति
verses.iast:
eṣa dattvā ca vittāni prāpya ca anuttamam yaśaḥ |
lokanāthaḥ purā bhūtvā sugrīvam nātham icchati
verses.translation: "He who gave away riches in charity, who obtained unequalled renown and who himself was the lord of this world earlier, now accepts the lordship of Sugreeva...

verses.devanagari:
सीता यस्य स्नुषा च आसीत् शरण्यो धर्मवत्सलः |
तस्य पुत्रः शरण्यस्य सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतः
verses.iast:
sītā yasya snuṣā ca āsIt śaraṇyo dharmavatsalaḥ |
tasya putraḥ śaraṇyasya sugrIvam śaraṇam gataḥ
verses.translation: "Who was a patron of virtue and who himself was a shelterer, to whom Seetha is the daughter-in-law, such a shelterer's son Rama is now taking shelter under Sugreeva...

glosses.meaning: to which, patron of dharma, shelterer

verses.devanagari:
सर्व लोकस्य धर्मात्मा शरण्यः शरणम् पुरा |
गुरुर् मे राघवः सोऽयम् सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतः
verses.iast:
sarva lokasya dharmātmā śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇam purā |
gurur me rāghavaḥ so'yam sugrIvam śaraṇam gataḥ
verses.translation: "He who is a virtuous one and protector of all the world, and who is the only refuge for all in earlier times... such a Raaghava, my mentor, is now seeking refuge with Sugreeva...

verses.devanagari:
यस्य प्रसादे सततम् प्रसीदेयुः इमाः प्रजाः |
स रामः वानरेन्द्रस्य प्रसादम् अभिकाङ्क्षते
verses.iast:
yasya prasāde satatam prasIdeyuḥ imāḥ prajāḥ |
sa rāmaḥ vānarendrasya prasādam abhikāñkśate
verses.translation: "By whose beneficence all these people are always delighted, he that Rama is now seeking benefaction from the lord of monkeys...

verses.devanagari:
येन सर्व गुणोपेताः पृथिव्याम् सर्व पार्थिवाः |
मानिताः सततम् राज्ञा सदा दशरथेन वै
तस्य अयम् पूर्वजः पुत्रः त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः |
सुग्रीवम् वानरेन्द्रम् तु रामः शरणम् आगतः
verses.iast:
yena sarva guṇopetāḥ pṛthivyām sarva pārthivāḥ |
mānitāḥ satatam rājñā sadā daśarathena vai
tasya ayam pUrvajaḥ putraḥ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ |
sugrIvam vānarendram tu rāmaḥ śaraṇam āgataḥ
verses.translation: "By which kingDasharatha, are all the kings with all possible good attributes are always, and at all the times were esteemed to be safeguarded as defensible kings, such king's eldest son Rama, renowned in all the three worlds for his own sheltering the needy, has now taken shelter under monkeys lord Sugreeva...

glosses.meaning: all kinds of, good attributes having
in three, worlds, renowned one [for his sheltering]
monkeys, lord, sugriivam = of Sugreeva, sharaNam gataH = shelter, taken.

verses.devanagari:
शोक अभिभूते रामे तु शोक आर्ते शरणम् गते |
कर्तुम् अर्हति सुग्रीवः प्रसादम् सह यूथपैः
verses.iast:
śoka abhibhūte rāme tu śoka ārte śaraṇam gate |
kartum arhati sugrīvaḥ prasādam saha yūthapaiḥ
verses.translation: "One who is rebuffed by sadness, and even agonised by it had already sought refuge, hence it is apt of Sugreeva to do favour in Rama's respect along with other vanara commanders..." Lakshmana said thus to Hanuma.

glosses.meaning: by sadness, one who is rebuffed
favour, to do, apt of him.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् ब्रुवाणम् सौमित्रिम् करुणम् स अश्रु पातनम् |
हनुमान् प्रति उवाच इदम् वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः
verses.iast:
evam bruvāṇam saumitrim karuṇam sa aśru pātanam |
hanumān prati uvāca idam vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ
verses.translation: To Lakshmana, who is telling that piteously with tears falling out, the eminently lettered Hanumaan said this in his return.

verses.devanagari:
ईदृशा बुद्धि संपन्ना जितक्रोधा जितेइन्द्रियाः |
द्रष्टव्या वानरेइन्द्रेण दिष्ट्या दर्शनम् आगताः
verses.iast:
īdṛśā buddhi sampannā jitakrodhā jiteindriyāḥ |
draṣṭavyā vānareindreṇa diṣṭyā darśanam āgatāḥ
verses.translation: "Intellectuals of your kind, who have conquered anger and senses are to be seen by the chief of monkeys Sugreeva, for your advent is godsend...

verses.devanagari:
स हि राज्यात् च विभ्रष्टः कृत वैरः च वालिना |
हृत दारो वने त्रस्तः भ्रात्रा विनिकृतः भृशम्
verses.iast:
sa hi rājyāt ca vibhraṣṭaḥ kṛta vairaḥ ca vālinā |
hṛta dāro vane trastaḥ bhrātrā vinikṛtaḥ bhṛśam
verses.translation: "He who is made as an enemy, very muchinsulted, and abrogated from kingdom by his own brother Vali, that Sugreeva is roaming about forests fearing him alone, his own brother Vali...

verses.devanagari:
करिष्यति स साहाय्यम् युवयोः भास्करात्मजः |
सुग्रीवः सह च अस्माभिः सीतायाः परिमार्गणे
verses.iast:
kariṣyati sa sāhāyyam yuvayoḥ bhāskarātmajaḥ |
sugrīvaḥ saha ca asmābhiḥ sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe
verses.translation: "He that son of Sun, Sugreeva, will render help to you two, joining forces of our like Vanara-s in searching Seetha..."

glosses.meaning: to you two, he will render, help.

verses.devanagari:
इति एवम् उक्त्वा हनुमान् श्लक्ष्णम् मधुरया गिरा |
बभाषे साधु गच्छामः सुग्रीवम् इति राघवम्
verses.iast:
iti evam uktvā hanumān ślakṣṇam madhurayā girā |
babhāṣe sādhu gacchāmaḥ sugrīvam iti rāghavam
verses.translation: Thus Hanuman on speaking melodious words with politeness, also said to Raghava as, "good, we may now approach Sugreeva...."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् ब्रुवन्तम् धर्मात्मा हनूमन्तम् स लक्ष्मणः |
प्रतिपूज्य यथा न्यायम् इदम् प्रोवाच राघवम्
verses.iast:
evam bruvantam dharmātmā hanūmantam sa lakṣmaṇaḥ |
pratipūjya yathā nyāyam idam provāca rāghavam
verses.translation: Hanuma when said thus virtuous Lakshmana adored him customarily in the way befitting to an envoy, and spoke this to Rama...

glosses.meaning: thus, who is saying, to that Hanuma

verses.devanagari:
कपिः कथयते हृष्टो यथा अयम् मारुतात्मजः |
कृत्यवान् सोऽपि संप्राप्तः कृत कृत्योऽसि राघव
verses.iast:
kapiḥ kathayate hṛṣṭo yathā ayam mārutātmajaḥ |
kṛtyavān so'pi samprāptaḥ kṛta kṛtyo'si rāghava
verses.translation: "Raghava, as to how this monkey seems to be happy in meeting us, by way of his narration, and he too neared us as an aspirant of some deed to be performed by us, hence joining them seems to fulfil your mission...

glosses.meaning: in happiness, as to how, he is telling

verses.devanagari:
प्रसन्न मुख वर्णः च व्यक्तम् हृष्टः च भाषते |
न अनृतम् वक्ष्यते वीरो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः
verses.iast:
prasanna mukha varṇaḥ ca vyaktam hṛṣṭaḥ ca bhāṣate |
na anṛtam vakṣyate vīro hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ
verses.translation: "He is talking with a lucid expression and pleasing facial tinge by which he seems to be gladdened at his heart... needless is telling untruths to such a valiant son of Air-god, Hanuma, isn't it!" So said Laskhmana to Rama

verses.devanagari:
ततः स सुमहाप्राज्ञः हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः |
जगाम आदाय तौ वीरौ हरि राजाय राघवौ
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa sumahāprājñaḥ hanumān mārutātmajaḥ |
jagāma ādāya tau vīrau hari rājāya rāghavau
verses.translation: Then he that very intelligent son of Air-god Hanuma, took those two valorous Raghava-s to go to the king of monkeys Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: valorous ones those two, Raghava-s, on taking

verses.devanagari:
भिक्षु रूपम् परित्यज्य वानरम् रूपम् आस्थितः |
पृष्टम् आरोप्य तौ वीरौ जगाम कपिकुङ्जरः
verses.iast:
bhikśu rUpam parityajya vAnaram rUpam Asthitaḥ |
pṛṣṭam Aropya tau vIrau jagAma kapikuñjaraḥ
verses.translation: On discarding the ascetic's semblance that estimable monkey Hanuma obtained his own monkey's form, and mounting those two valiant ones onto his back he proceeded towards Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: monkey, the elephant like estimable one
those, two valiant ones, onto his back, on mounting

verses.devanagari:
स तु विपुल यशाः कपि प्रवीरः पवनसुतः कृत कृत्यवत् प्रहृष्टः |
गिरि वरम् उरुविक्रमः प्रयातः स शुभमतिः सह राम लक्ष्मणाभ्याम्
verses.iast:
sa tu vipula yaśāḥ kapi pravīraḥ pavanasutaḥ kṛta kṛtyavat prahṛṣṭaḥ |
giri varam uruvikramaḥ prayātaḥ sa śubhamatiḥ saha rāma lakṣmaṇābhyām
verses.translation: Hanuma, the extensively renowned heroic son of Air-god with pious mind and highly audacious nature, is then gladdened like the one whose difficult deed is just accomplished, thus he gladly travelled to that mountain where Sugreeva is abiding, along with Rama and Lakshmana.
